about: Fuel shape and size for tests whose own table does not state them, taken from NASA's reports in PSI (item 10). Each entry is one investigation-level statement: the shape (and size, when given) of the burner or sample used for the listed tests, the file, page and NASA's exact words. Hand-checked by workstream A against data_extra/_text (scripts/fetch_psi_docs.py, scripts/extract_docs.py). build_web_data.py applies these to tests.json; validate_data.py checks them and re-finds every quote when data_extra/_text exists. Solid samples are never given a shape from here: only their own fuel cell or size columns are used.
